name: overleaf-latex
description: Create, edit and compile LaTeX documents in your signed-in Overleaf account.

interface.shortDescription: Create and compile LaTeX in Overleaf.
interface.longDescription: Work with your Overleaf projects through thirteen MCP tools: create projects, initialize empty files, apply bounded versioned edits with strict compilation and conditional recovery, inspect private checkpoints, and retrieve current PDFs or paginated logs. Uses a locally saved Overleaf session, including Google sign-in. An independent personal integration.
defaultPrompt: Create and compile a LaTeX article in Overleaf.
Help me edit an existing Overleaf project.
Compile my Overleaf document and fix its errors.
